questions.stemHtml: A 32-year-old patient underwent renal Biopsy for nephrotic syndrome. Along with glomerular pathology, arterioles show the lesions as depicted in the histopathological picture. Identify the lesion:
questions.solutionHtml:
Hyaline arteriolosclerosis

Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 492, 501

questions.topic: eGurukul · Normal Vessel, Hypertensive Changes & Sclerosis
questions.stemHtml: A 54-year-old male patient with an irregular intake of hypertensive medication underwent renal biopsy for hypertension-induced decreased renal function and arterioles shows changes as depicted in the picture. What's your diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Hyperplastic Arteriolosclerosis

As patient is hypertensive and histopath image is given which gives the diagnosis of hyperplastic arteriosclerosis.



Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 492, 493

questions.topic: eGurukul · Normal Vessel, Hypertensive Changes & Sclerosis
questions.stem: All of the following statements are true regarding Mönckeberg medial sclerosis except:

options.label: B
options.text: It's a type of calcification in media

options.label: C
options.text: It can lead to vascular occlusion and medical emergency

options.label: D
options.text: Seen in walls of muscular arteries, typically involving the internal elastic membrane

questions.answerText: It can lead to vascular occlusion and medical emergency
questions.solutionHtml:
It can lead to vascular occlusion and medical emergency

The calcifications do NOT encroach on the vessel lumen and are usually not clinically significant.



Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 493
